description: Ari is coordinating the clearing of the family's old farmhouse and must decide where several remaining items will go, how the dining table will be moved, and when each handoff will happen after checking in with four relatives.

agents.name: Ari
agents.role: Farmhouse Clearance Coordinator and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family farmhouse must be cleared of its remaining contents by August 31.
shared_context.S2: The items still needing a disposition plan are an oak dining table, a sewing cabinet, twelve boxes of books, and four framed paintings.
shared_context.S3: Ari is coordinating the clear-out and will make the final plan for the items, their transport, and their handoff dates.
shared_context.S4: The family's usual practice is to go around the group before finalizing a family logistics plan so everyone can raise relevant practical or personal considerations.
shared_context.S5: The family wants the items either kept by relatives or passed to organizations that can use them.

PF1.text: Theo wants to keep the sewing cabinet and can collect it from the farmhouse on August 24; he has not yet said this to Ari.

PF2.text: Maya measured the farmhouse: the front doorway is 88 centimeters wide, the side doorway is 110 centimeters wide, and the oak table is 96 centimeters wide, so the table can leave intact through the side doorway but not the front.

PF3.text: Jon spoke with the county historical society, which agreed to accept all four framed paintings if they are delivered between August 20 and August 22; that arrangement has not reached the group yet.

PF4.text: Nina confirmed with the neighborhood library that it will accept all twelve boxes of books and can collect them on August 23; she has not shared that confirmation with Ari.

acceptance_conditions: Theo must be designated to keep the sewing cabinet.
The sewing cabinet must be collected on August 24.
The oak table must leave intact through the side doorway.
The four paintings must go to the county historical society.
The paintings must be delivered on a date from August 20 through August 22.
The twelve boxes of books must go to the neighborhood library.
The books must be collected on August 23.
Commitments must cover Theo's sewing-cabinet collection, the side-door table move, historical-society delivery, and library book collection.
Ari must cite Jon's historical-society confirmation after Jon has revealed it.

content_checks.C4: decisions['paintings_destination'] in ['county_historical_society', 'County historical society', 'county historical society', 'County Historical Society']
content_checks.C5: decisions['paintings_delivery_date'] in ['August 20', 'August 21', 'August 22', 'August 20-22', 'August 20–22', 'Between August 20 and August 22', 'August 20 to August 22'] or 'August 20-22' in decisions['paintings_delivery_date'] or 'August 20–22' in decisions['paintings_delivery_date']
content_checks.C9: any((c['type'] == 'collection' or c['type'] == 'transport') and (('sewing cabinet' in c['target']) or ('sewing cabinet' in c['detail'])) and (('August 24' in c['target']) or ('August 24' in c['detail'])) and (('Theo' in c['target']) or ('Theo' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] == 'transport' and (c['target'] in ['oak dining table', 'oak table', 'Oak dining table', 'Oak table']) and (('side door' in c['detail'] or 'side doorway' in c['detail']) and (('110 cm' in c['detail']) or ('110cm' in c['detail']))) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any((c['type'] == 'delivery' or c['type'] == 'delivery_window') and (c['target'] in ['county historical society', 'County historical society', 'County Historical Society', 'four framed paintings', 'Four framed paintings']) and (('August 20-22' in c['detail']) or ('August 20–22' in c['detail']) or ('August 20 and August 22' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C12: any((c['type'] == 'collection' or c['type'] == 'transport') and (c['target'] in ['neighborhood library', 'Neighborhood library', 'Neighborhood Library', 'twelve boxes of books', 'Twelve boxes of books']) and ('August 23' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Theo's stated wish changes the sewing-cabinet recipient to Theo, his available date changes collection to August 24, and it creates the required sewing-cabinet collection commitment.
The exact doorway and table widths change the table method to moving it intact through the side doorway and require the matching move commitment.
The historical society's acceptance changes the paintings destination to that society, restricts delivery to August 20-22, requires its delivery commitment, and supplies the fact Ari must cite.
The library's confirmation changes the books destination to the neighborhood library, fixes collection on August 23, and requires the library collection commitment.
